description:
The 30+ detectors in `crystal_rules.ml` share several repetitive patterns that obscure the actual rule logic.

**Pattern 1 — "iterate mod_items, match IFunction, walk body, accumulate"** appears 30+ times verbatim:

    let collected = ref [] in
    List.iter (fun item ->
      match item.item_value with
      | IFunction (_, _, _, body) -> ...
      | _ -> ()
    ) m.mod_items;
    !collected

**Pattern 2 — "for each function body, collect all (name, line) calls, then filter"** appears in 25+ detectors:

    let calls = collect_app_names body in
    List.concat_map (fun (name, line) -> ...) calls

**Pattern 3 — "generic AST walker that recurses through EBlock | ELet | EApp | EIf | ECase | EFn | ETryCatchFinally | _"** is duplicated in 10+ detectors (`detect_open_rescue`, `detect_missing_else`, `detect_reassignment_in_condition`, `detect_unless_with_else`, `detect_global_variable`, `detect_float_equality`, `detect_empty_string_comparison`, `detect_negated_comparison`, `detect_redundant_self`, `find_chains`, `find_nested_ternaries`, etc.).

**Pattern 4 — "scan_block / scan helper" pattern** is hand-rolled in 8+ places with slight variations.

**Proposed helpers** (in `crystal_rules_helpers.ml`):

```ocaml
(** Run f on the body of every IFunction (or IModule/IClass member function) in the module *)
val map_functions : t -> (string -> pattern list -> expr -> (string * int) list) -> (string * int) list

(** Map f over every expression in a body, threading through EBlock/ELet/EIf/ECase/EFn/ETryCatchFinally *)
val map_subexpressions : (expr -> 'a list) -> expr -> 'a list

(** Pre-order walk that visits every expression node once *)
val iter_subexpressions : (expr -> unit) -> expr -> unit

(** Check if a call name starts with any of a list of prefixes *)
val name_starts_with_any : string -> string list -> bool

(** Check if a call name ends with any of a list of suffixes *)
val name_ends_with_any : string -> string list -> bool

(** Check if a string contains a substring (case-insensitive option) *)
val path_contains_substring : ?case_insensitive:bool -> string -> string -> bool
```

After the refactor, each detector should be ~10-20 lines of rule-specific logic instead of ~40 lines of plumbing.

**Risk:** Behavior must remain byte-identical on the existing test corpus (`test/samples/smell_samples/complex.cr`, `god.cr`, etc.). After refactor, compare `catseye-ocaml --rules src/ocaml/rules --format json test/samples/smell_samples/` before and after.

Blocks: catseye-ozj (refactor epic)
Depends on: catseye-4o6 (split into submodules — combinators live in helpers, used by every submodule)
